title: EXCLUSIVE: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Opens First West Coast Boutique at South Coast Plaza
summary: The luxury fragrance house is expanding its U.S. retail footprint with a new California location and plans for a fifth boutique in Dallas.

extraction.key_fact: 메종 프란시스 커정이 캘리포니아에 미국 서부 첫 부티크를 열고 매장을 늘리고 있다.
